description: A PDF Canvas for PeachDrawing.Core: draw shapes, text, images, gradients and effects and write them as PDF, with fonts embedded and subset, PDF/A and PDF/X conformance, encryption and tagged output, in pure .NET.

A vector SVG Canvas for PeachDrawing.Core - draw shapes, gradients, clips, text and images and save them as SVG, with paths, curves, gradients and glyph outlines kept as vector content and no PDF, HTML or CSS involved.
Parses HTML, CSS, SVG and MathML, resolves the cascade and lays the document out into pages, then paints them onto any PeachDrawing canvas: PDF, a bitmap, or your own.
